proves.claim: statusLines prints the staffing line from format.staffingLines(summary.staffing) directly after the capacity lines, and none without staffing.

cli.logic-status-render.staffing-line.why: Without it, status could print the staffing line elsewhere or print one on boards that carry no staffing.

proves.claim: With 6 ready items, no max-useful figure and the default ratio, the staffing line reads 6 builders, 1 reviewer (8:1).

cli.logic-status-render.staffing-input.why: Without it, a change to the staffing wording or default ratio would reach the coordinator staffing step unnoticed.

proves.claim: The real status command on a scratch board prints the staffing line computed from its ready items and the max-useful result, and carries staffing in its JSON summary.

cli.logic-status-render.real-status.why: Without it, the render could pass while status never computes or passes the staffing figures.
